headline: Tasty everyday veg meals, bina ghanto kitchen mein bitaye
bio: Hi, main Ananya hoon. Main working professionals aur beginners ko sikhati hoon kaise ghar ka tasty aur healthy khana jaldi banayein, bina kisi jhanjhat ke. Agar office ke baad cooking ek task lagta hai, toh aap sahi jagah aaye hain.

products.title: 20-Minute Dinner Guide
products.tierReason: A small, quick-win guide that is very affordable for a first-time buyer on a phone.
products.summary: Quick dinner recipes jo 20 minute mein ban jayein.
products.description: Busy office days ke liye 15 simple vegetarian dinner recipes ka PDF guide. Isme step-by-step instructions hain taaki aap thake hone ke baad bhi jald se jald ek accha khana bana sakein.
whatYouGet: PDF ebook with 15 quick dinner recipes
Ingredient substitution list for common items

products.title: Weekly Meal Planner & Grocery Tracker
products.tierReason: A solid, ready-to-use template pack that saves daily decision fatigue.
products.summary: Apne poore hafte ka khana aur grocery list pehle se plan karein.
products.description: No more daily confusion about 'aaj kya banayein'. Ye ready-to-use digital templates aapko hafte bhar ke khane ki planning karne aur grocery wastage kam karne mein help karenge.

products.title: Sabzi & Dal Masterclass
products.tierReason: A live interactive session with direct creator access provides strong value.
products.summary: Roshan karein apni daily cooking ko with perfect basic recipes.
products.description: Ek live 90-minute zoom session jismein main daily daal aur tasty sabziyan banane ke secret tips sikhaungi. Aap apne cooking doubts live pooch sakte hain.
